n: 24 In. Black Stainless Steel Built-in Convection Microwave Oven With Speed And Sensor Cooking
desc: Luxury isn’t meant to be desired - it’s meant to be attainable. Inspired by Lake Tahoe, USA, the ZLINE 24" Built-in Convection Microwave Oven in Black Stainless Steel with Speed and Sensor Cooking with Speed and Sensor Cooking (MWO-24-BS) provides a professional culinary experience by pairing unmatched performance with timeless style.
hl: Select from a variety of convection, broil, and microwave cooking settings to provide optimal dish results
Get the results you need with 10 different power levels and a powerful 1000 watt cooking power
Achieve optimal performance for every dish with sensor cooking, reheat, defrost, and rapid pre-heat settings
Enjoy an easy-to-use crystal clear LCD display and timer
A durable ceramic turntable provides an even heat distribution and can be turned clockwise or counter clockwise
An included microwave rack offers maximum convection performance, for best results place face down for baking or roasting and face up for grilling
